Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring landlords to provide tenants with written receipts upon request under the manufactured/mobile home landlord-tenant act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the manufactured/mobile home landlordtenantact; and adding a new section to chapter 59.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 59.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A landlord shall provide, upon the request of a tenant, a writtenreceipt for any payments made by the tenant. The receipt must beprovided to the tenant within fifteen business days of the request. Atenant may request any receipt for sums paid within the previous twelvemonths.
